desc: Re-engineered and retooled, UMC Leadless features a new generation of improved, non-lead bullets ready for your range. New Catalyst clean priming technology eliminates lead exposure at the firing line, while copper jacketed compressed core projectiles reduce splash back from steel targets near or far. Duplicating the ballistics of conventional lead core ammunition, UMC Leadless is available in 223 Remington and 9MM Luger.
